title: San Diego 2012 — Get Registration Code
description: Historical introduction to the San Diego 2012 OpenStack Summit contributor free-pass programme. Registration and code issuance are no longer available on this archive.
archiveNotice: Archived 2012 registration information. The offer and deadlines below are historical. The current public page no longer provides the referenced survey, and this archive does not collect contributor information or issue registration codes.
body:
San Diego 2012 conference archive

Claim Your Free Pass... After Just A Few Quick Questions

Your Free Pass

Congratulations! As an Active Technical Contributor (ATC) you qualify for a code (expires 8/31) to get a FREE pass to the upcoming OpenStack Summit in San Diego (October 15th-18th). All you need to do is fill out the brief survey below.

Why We're Collecting This Info 

First, we'd like to better accomodate you at the summit. Second, In a few weeks we plan to publish a directory of each ATC and this survey will help us get that started. Don't worry, you'll have another chance to review your information before the directory is published. At the end of this painless little survey, you'll get your special link to register for FREE to the Summit.
